name: חוֹבָה
summary: Hobah is a place north of Damascus, as far as which Abram pursued the kings. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: עַד חוֹבָה gives the endpoint of the pursuit. The relative clause identifies the place by its position north of Damascus.

note: Moved from the former word entry `7wobaah`. The old root key חובה used the place name’s own consonants. Its derivation is uncertain.
